scheme_name: Subsidy for Fund Raising from SME Exchange
other_conditions: Must be a newly established micro or small enterprise set up in one of the declared 254 industrially backward blocks.
Applicant must qualify for listing on the SME Exchange in accordance with NSE/BSE norms.
Only merchant banker fees, due diligence fees, registrar and transfer agent fees, peer review auditor fees, exchange fees, and listing charges are eligible for reimbursement.
Application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of listing on the SME Exchange.
benefits_summary: Assistance up to ₹30,00,000, covering up to 50% of the total SME IPO expenditure.
